caption:
This week's real anime rankings story isn't who's #1, it's who's climbing fastest.

We pulled ANN's weekly episode rankings and did the week-over-week math ourselves instead of just reprinting the chart. One Piece jumped from #29 to #5 in a single week, which is a wild thing for a show that long to still do.

Which one of these six do you think keeps climbing next week?

Save this so you can check back once the new numbers drop.
